notes.title: Google Earth VR Update - Feb. 13, 2018
notes.notes:
Release Notes:

  Navigation enabled in Street View peek mode (when you place the preview sphere over your head).
  Crossfading between Street View 360 photo transitions.
  Enabled button on nondominant controller to slow down flight speed.
  Bug fixes.

notes.title: Google Earth VR Update - Sept. 29, 2017
notes.notes:
Release Notes:

Updated pre-installed cache data
Fixed crash at start when audio device’s sample rate is 192 kHz
Fixed crash when trying to display a message about why Earth VR could not start
Fixed formatting issue with Street View photo attribution
Fixed bug where Street View photo address would sometimes not update

notes.title: Google Earth VR v1.2 update
notes.notes: Today we pushed a minor update to refresh the UI of the mirror window. We also upgraded the cache system — please note that upload size is larger than usual due to this change.
